verdict.rationale: Sprinto's quickstart docs say it lets teams manage SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS and others in one place, and a Framework Health API suggests frameworks are handled within the platform. GDPR also gets extra depth through Sprinto's compliance-skills repo, which offers codebase-based gap analysis. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on HIPAA and PCI DSS control mapping and workflows (the evidence is a one-line marketing claim), independent or hands-on confirmation of multi-framework use, and detail on how adding a new framework reuses existing controls and evidence.
